summary_en: ROE 8.87% (FY3/26), WACC 3.48%, PBR 0.63x. FY3/27 guidance: ROE to decline slightly, WACC steady, PBR target above 1.0x. New metrics: revenue growth 7.5%, per-capita sales ¥28.75M, return rate 31.63%, new-business investment ¥170M. Four consecutive periods of net profit recovery (¥1,210M FY3/26).
title_en: Notice Regarding Progress Status of Measures for Realizing Management with Awareness of Capital Cost and Share Price
translation_en_brief:
Shobunsha Holdings reported progress on its capital-cost and share-price management initiative, disclosed in June 2025. The update covers the four-period trailing record of key performance indicators (WACC, ROE, PBR) and new proprietary metrics (revenue growth, per-capita sales, publication return rate, new-business investment).

FY3/26 (ended March 2026) results: ROE 8.87%, WACC 3.48%, PBR 0.63x; consolidated net profit ¥1,210M (fourth consecutive period of profitability). Revenue grew 7.5% to ¥6,727M. New disclosures include per-capita sales ¥28.75M, return rate 31.63% (below industry average), and new-business investment ¥170M to support M&A and growth initiatives.

FY3/27 guidance signals ROE to decline slightly as M&A investments precede returns, WACC to remain steady despite rising interest rates, and continued focus on lifting PBR above 1.0x. Management frames the operating environment as subject to geopolitical risk, inflation, and rate pressures, making capital-efficiency discipline more critical. Cost-reduction phase complete; transition to growth-and-digital acceleration underway.
